none: PAS KENT-1F29CC: Q Radiate of Allectus
contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP C ALLECTVS P F AVG ; R/ [VI]RTVS AVG

A fine Roman but slightly abraded copper-alloy Q-Radiate of Allectus, (AD r.293-296 ) (Reece period 14), minted at London. RIC V, pt 2, p. 563, no. 55. Obverse type: Radiate and cuirassed bearded bust right. Obverse legend: IMP C ALLECTVS P F AVG. Reverse type: galley rowing left with mast, cabin and no rowers; waves. Reverse legend: [VI]RTVS AVG. Mint mark: -//QL. Coin remains in good condiitons…
